book.title: Career and Technical Education Grade 7 Student Textbook
book.subject: cte

title: Pest and disease management
competency: Explain how to manage pests and diseases safely.

keywords.def: An insect or animal that harms plants.
A chemical sprayed on soil or plants to kill pests.
An insect that helps the garden, for example by eating pests.

en.text: Pests harm plants. Keep plants healthy with sun, water and fertile soil. Grow flowers that attract beneficial insects. Choose resistant seeds and healthy transplants. Pesticides can be used, but wear gloves, a face mask and eye glasses because they harm people.

screens.title: Pests!
screens.ask: Aphids are eating Meron's cabbages. Which step comes FIRST?
opts: Keep plants healthy and grow flowers for helpful insects
Spray strong chemicals with bare hands
screens.after: Healthy plants and helpful insects are the first defence. Chemicals come last, with safety gear.

screens.title: 3.1.7 Pest and disease management
paras: Keep plants healthy with enough sun, water and fertility.
Grow flowering plants that attract beneficial insects. They control pests and help pollination.

screens.title: Choosing and spraying
paras: Select disease- and pest-resistant seeds or plants.
Choose transplants that are healthy and free of insects.
You can also use pesticides, chemicals sprayed on soil or plants.
When spraying, wear gloves, a face mask and eye glasses. Pesticides harm people.

screens.title: Key words
defs: An insect or animal that harms plants.
A chemical sprayed on soil or plants to kill pests.
An insect that helps the garden, for example by eating pests.

screens.text: Why should a gardener wear a face mask when spraying pesticides?
opts: To keep insects off the face
screens.why: The book says pesticides harm the health of humans.
screens.clue: What can the chemical do to you?

screens.text: Tap the safety items for spraying pesticides.
screens.why: The book names gloves, face masks and eye glasses.
screens.clue: Protect hands, nose and mouth, and eyes.

screens.text: Flowering plants can help control pests.
Yonas buys seedlings. Some have small insects on the leaves. What should he do?
opts: Mix them with the healthy ones
screens.why: The book says choose transplants that are healthy and free of insects and disease. Infested seedlings bring pests into the garden.

items.title: Group garden: order the jobs
items: Pick a site in the school compound
Prepare a bed and get tools
Water, weed and protect from pests
items.why: Your group of 5 follows the steps from 3.1.5 to 3.1.7.

opts: A chemical sprayed to kill pests
test.ans: A chemical sprayed to kill pests

test.text: Eye glasses are safety gear when spraying.
What is the safest first way to fight pests?
opts: Keep plants healthy and attract helpful insects
test.ans: Keep plants healthy and attract helpful insects
